description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

CoStar Realty Information, Inc. is hiring an Associate Software Engineer to develop tools for its proprietary platform, supporting sales and research teams across its real estate brands. The role involves building modern web applications and collaborating with experienced engineers on code, automated tests, reviews, and design and planning discussions.
Associate Software Engineer developing platform tools for sales and research, writing code and automated tests, participating in code reviews

Responsibilities:
• This role develops tools that power CoStar Group’s proprietary platform, supporting sales and research teams across our portfolio of brands - including Homes.com, CoStar.com, Apartments.com, and LoopNet.com
• At CoStar Group, our engineering teams build innovative, scalable solutions while following industry best practices for software development
• You'll collaborate with experienced engineers to write clean, maintainable code, develop automated tests, participate in code reviews, and contribute to cross-functional design and planning discussions

Requirements:
• Currently pursuing a bachelor's degree from an accredited, not-for-profit university or college in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a comparable major
• Must have an expected graduation date of December 2026 - June 2027
• Minimum 3.0 cumulative GPA
• At least 2 months of previous relevant internship or co-op experience
• Experience applying software engineering fundamentals through coursework, projects, internships, or work experience
• Ability to discuss prior internship, project, or academic work, including the problem solved, technical approach, collaboration, and outcomes
• currently eligible to work full-time in the United States
• CoStar Group is not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position

Preferred:
• Experience writing understandable, maintainable, and well-documented code
• Interest in learning new technologies and building high-quality software
• Demonstrated initiative and collaboration through academic, internship, extracurricular, or team-based experiences
• Familiarity with Agile development practices, the Software Development Lifecycle, APIs, web services, or application design concepts
• Exposure to programming languages, databases, cloud concepts, AI/machine learning, frameworks, or other technical tools through coursework, projects, internships, or personal learning
